response.outreach_email:
Subject: Fellow Copperline alum curious about lending product

Hi Grace,

I'm Noah Bennett, an MBA candidate (Class of 2028). I was an analyst at Copperline Bank from 2021 to 2026 and built three credit risk models there, so your path from Risk Analyst at Copperline to Head of Lending Product at Pebble Pay caught my eye.

I'm aiming for lending product roles in fintech. I'd love to hear how your risk experience has helped in a product role. Would you be open to a 20-minute coffee chat in the next few weeks? I'm happy to work around your schedule.

Thanks,
Noah
questions: When you left your Risk Analyst role at Copperline for Pebble Pay in 2018, what role did you step into, and how did you position your risk background for it?
As Head of Lending Product, which habits from your Copperline risk days do you rely on most, and which did you have to unlearn to think like a product leader?
How does your lending product team at Pebble Pay work with the people who own credit risk? When product goals and risk models pull in different directions, how do those tradeoffs get resolved?
Having seen lending from inside a bank like Copperline and now from a fintech, what is the biggest difference in how lending products get designed and launched?

For someone coming out of an MBA with credit risk modeling experience but no formal product title, what would make them credible for a lending product role on your team, and what gaps would you expect them to close first?

thanks so much for making time to chat.
I'm Noah Bennett, and I'm an MBA candidate in the Class of 2028.
I've always been a numbers person.
I earned a B.S. in Mathematics, and then I spent 2021 to 2026 as an analyst at Copperline Bank.
I have to say, it's a fun bit of common ground that
we both worked at Copperline, just in different years.
At Copperline, I built three credit risk models.
That work gave me a real appreciation for how much thinking goes into every credit decision.
I also trained five new hires,
and that ended up being one of the most rewarding parts of the job for me.
I love teaching and mentoring
, and it's a thread that runs through a lot of what I do.
I was also chess club president.

These days, I'm interested in fintech, and I'm targeting product roles at fintech companies, specifically in lending or payments. My goal is to use my risk modeling background to build lending products.
I'm excited by the idea of moving from evaluating risk to helping shape the products themselves.
That's a big part of why I was so eager to talk with you.
You were a Risk Analyst at Copperline from 2014 to 2018, joined Pebble Pay in 2018, and you're now Head of Lending Product there.
That's the kind of path I'm hoping to learn from, so I'm really curious
how your risk experience helps in a lending product role
